en.name: Sourdough bread
en.summary: A thick-crusted sourdough loaf keeps 3–5 days at room temperature, cut face down on a board or in a paper bag — never in plastic. Do not refrigerate it unless you will toast it. Frozen at −18 °C (0 °F) it holds 3 months, and freezing is the only thing that actually stops staling.
en.pantry: 3–5 days, cut face down on a wooden board or in a paper bag or a cloth. A study that stored bread in plastic bags, paper bags and bread boxes found the paper bag held the lowest humidity, around 80 %, and the latest mould, while the plastic bag sat near 90 % and moulded a day or so sooner. A thick-crusted loaf holds its own moisture and the acidity of the leaven slows mould further, which is why a whole loaf outlasts a sliced one by days. This span is our reading of those results rather than a published figure — treat it as quality guidance.
en.fridge: No. The same study measured a mixed-type sourdough firming to 398 % of its initial value over ten days at 8.2 °C, against 330 % at 21.9 °C: refrigeration made it noticeably staler than leaving it on the counter did. Starch retrogradation runs fastest just above freezing, and no amount of sourdough acidity changes that. The fridge is defensible only for bread heading into a toaster, because toasting re-gelatinises the starch and undoes the staling — but it does nothing at all about mould, and in a hot humid kitchen where mould is the real enemy, the freezer beats the fridge outright.
en.freezer: 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality, read across from commercially baked sliced bread. Freeze it the day it cools, sliced, in a sealed bag — or freeze half the loaf whole and refresh it from frozen in a hot oven for about twenty minutes, which brings the crust back properly in a way that a slice never does. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond that; the limit is drying, ice crystals and freezer burn.
en.thawing: Toast slices straight from frozen, or refresh a frozen half-loaf in a hot oven without thawing. A loaf thawed in the fridge and still cold may be refrozen with some quality loss; one thawed on a warm counter should not be.
spoilage: Any fuzzy mould — throw the whole loaf out rather than cutting round it, because mould hyphae invade deeply into a food this porous.
A pink, orange or black growth, which is a clear discard signal.
A crumb dried hard enough to crumble rather than tear.
A sharply vinegary or acetone smell well past the normal sourdough tang.
tips: Cut face down on a board is the best storage a whole loaf can have.
Paper or cloth, never a plastic bag — plastic raises the humidity and brings mould forward.
Buy or bake whole loaves and slice as you go.
Freeze half the loaf on baking day and refresh it whole in a hot oven later.

faq.q: How long does sourdough bread last?
faq.a: 3–5 days at room temperature with the cut face down, in paper or cloth rather than plastic.

faq.q: Should sourdough go in the fridge?
faq.a: No, unless you will toast it. Measured firmness rose faster at fridge temperature than at room temperature, so chilling makes it stale sooner.

faq.q: Can you cut mould off sourdough?
faq.a: No. Bread is porous and the hyphae run far deeper than the visible patch. Throw the loaf out.

zh.name: 酸種麵包
zh.summary: 厚皮的酸種麵包切面朝下擺在木板上、或裝紙袋，放室溫可放 3～5 天——絕對不要用塑膠袋。除非要烤過再吃，否則不要冷藏。−18 °C 冷凍可放 3 個月，而冷凍是唯一真的能讓老化停下來的方法。
zh.pantry: 切面朝下擺在木板上，或裝紙袋、用布包，3～5 天。一份把麵包分別放在塑膠袋、紙袋和麵包盒裡的研究發現，紙袋內的濕度最低、大約 80 %，長霉也最晚；塑膠袋則接近 90 %，長霉早了一天左右。厚皮的整條麵包自己就抓得住水分，酸種的酸度又進一步拖慢黴菌，這就是為什麼整條會比切片多撐好幾天。這個區間是我們對那些結果的解讀，不是公布的數字，請當成品質參考。
zh.fridge: 不要。同一份研究量到，一款混合型酸種在 8.2 °C 放十天後硬度上升到原本的 398 %，而在 21.9 °C 只有 330 %：冷藏讓它比擺在檯面上明顯更老。澱粉回凝在略高於冰點時最快，酸種再酸也改變不了這件事。冷藏只有在麵包要進烤麵包機時才說得過去，因為烤會讓澱粉重新糊化、把老化抵消掉——但烤對霉完全沒有用，而在霉才是真正敵人的濕熱廚房裡，冷凍完勝冷藏。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 3 個月品質最好，這是比照市售切片麵包而來。放涼那天就切片、密封裝袋冷凍；或者把半條整塊冷凍，之後直接從冷凍進高溫烤箱回烤大約二十分鐘，外皮會真正回來，那是切片永遠做不到的。只要全程沒退冰，超過這個期限仍然安全；限制它的是變乾、冰晶和凍燒。
zh.thawing: 切片直接從冷凍烤，或把冷凍的半條不解凍直接進高溫烤箱回烤。在冷藏解凍、還是冰的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；在溫暖檯面上解凍過的就不要再凍。
spoilage: 只要長出絨毛霉就整條丟掉，不要切掉那塊繼續吃；麵包這麼多孔，菌絲會往深處鑽。
出現粉紅色、橘色或黑色的菌落，那是明確該丟的訊號。
內裡乾到一撕就碎，撕不出組織。
出現刺鼻的醋酸味或像去光水的味道，遠超過酸種正常的那點酸香。
tips: 切面朝下放木板，是整條麵包能得到最好的保存方式。
用紙或布，絕對不要塑膠袋——塑膠會把濕度拉高，讓霉提早報到。
買整條或烤整條，吃到哪裡切到哪裡。
出爐當天先冷凍半條，之後整塊進高溫烤箱回烤。

faq.a: 切面朝下、用紙或布不要用塑膠袋，放室溫 3～5 天。
不要，除非你打算烤過再吃。實測的硬度上升在冷藏溫度下比室溫更快，所以冰它反而更早變老。

faq.q: 酸種麵包長霉可以切掉再吃嗎？
faq.a: 不行。麵包多孔，菌絲遠比看得見的那塊深。整條丟掉。
